title: Science: Animals 🦁
summary:
1. Animal Body Parts (Bagian Tubuh):
Head (Kepala), Body (Badan), Leg & Foot (Kaki), Tail (Ekor), Wings (Sayap), Beak (Paruh), dan Fins (Sirip).

2. Skin Coverings (Penutup Tubuh):
Untuk melindungi diri (safe) dan tetap hangat (warm).
🐻 Fur: Lion, Bear, Cat.
🦩 Feathers: Flamingo, Duck.
🐍 Scales: Snake, Fish.
🦔 Spikes: Hedgehog.

3. Babies & Growth (Pertumbuhan):
Bertelur (lay eggs) atau melahirkan (give birth). Bayi hewan (young) akan tumbuh (grow) dan berubah (change).

4. Survival Needs (Kebutuhan Hidup):
Agar bisa hidup, hewan butuh Food (Makanan), Water (Air), Air (Udara), dan Shelter (Tempat berlindung yang aman).

5. Animal Diets (Makanan Hewan):
🥩 Carnivore: Meat eater (Pemakan daging. Cth: Lion, Tiger).
🌿 Herbivore: Plant eater (Pemakan tumbuhan. Cth: Cow, Elephant).
🍎🥩 Omnivore: Eats both (Makan keduanya. Cth: Bear, Human).

6. Special Groups:
🐜 Insects (Serangga): Memiliki 6 kaki (6 legs).
🐄 Mammals (Mamalia): Memiliki rambut/bulu (fur) dan minum susu (drink milk).

questions.questionText: Birds and flamingos have ______ as their skin covering.
Bears and lions have ______ as their skin covering.
Young animals go through changes as they ______.
Why do animals have skin coverings? All of these are correct, EXCEPT... (Kecuali...)
questions.hint: Cari jawaban yang BURUK atau SALAH (Except = Kecuali).

questions.questionText: What do all animals need to survive? (Apa yang dibutuhkan hewan untuk hidup?)
questions.hint: Hewan butuh hal yang sama seperti manusia untuk hidup.

questions.questionText: A cow eats grass and leaves. What do we call a plant-eater?
A tiger eats meat. What do we call a meat-eater?
Match the animal to its skin covering! (Tarik garis ke penutup kulitnya)
Match the animal to its special body parts! (Tarik garis ke bagian tubuhnya)
Match the baby animal to its parent! (I look like my parent!)
questions.hint: Puppy adalah anak anjing, Kitten adalah anak kucing.

questions.questionText: Match the animals with what they eat!
questions.hint: Ingat catatan materi tentang Makanan Hewan.
